defects.justification: importer.go imports modernc.org/sqlite but go.mod contains only `module csvimport` and `go 1.22` with no require directive (and no go.sum), so the dependency is undeclared and its version unpinned.
http.ListenAndServe is used with no http.Server timeouts (ReadHeaderTimeout/ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout), so slow clients uploading up to 64 MiB can hold connections indefinitely.
POST /imports and the status/error endpoints have no authentication, so any caller can bulk insert or overwrite customer records (upsert by email) in the customer database.

Every accepted upload spawns a new background goroutine and a temp file of up to 64 MiB with no limit on concurrent or queued imports, so repeated uploads exhaust disk, CPU and the single DB connection.
countRows ignores every non-EOF error from r.Read() and just increments n; a persistent read error makes the loop spin forever, and parse errors are silently counted as rows.
